test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement:**

India is a country of multiple languages.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Indians can speak multiple languages.

II. Every country has multiple languages.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Conclusions:

I. All Indians can speak multiple languages. - Does not follow (The statement implies that multiple languages exist in India. However, this is not enough to determine if every Indian speaks more than one language or not.)

II. Every country has multiple languages. - Does not follow (The statement does not mention any other country apart from India. So, this cannot be determined.)

Hence, neither conclusion I nor II follows.
